PACES (Performance, Architecture, Capability, Evaluation, and Security) is an engineering and evaluation framework designed to benchmark AI systems, ensure model reliability, and validate secure autonomous workflows.
PACES stands for Performance, Architecture, Capability, Evaluation, and Security—a systematic framework for developing and evaluating high-performance, secure AI models and agents.
PACES is an architectural framework focusing on Performance, Architecture, Capability, Evaluation, and Security for modern language models and autonomous agents.
PACES (Performance, Architecture, Capability, Evaluation & Security) is the core methodology used to evaluate system performance, robust model architecture, and secure tool execution.

PACES evaluates five critical pillars of an AI system: Performance (speed and efficiency), Architecture (transformer and neural design), Capability (problem solving and coding), Evaluation (empirical benchmarks and perplexity), and Security (safe execution and access control).
PACES stands for Performance, Architecture, Capability, Evaluation, and Security. It provides a standard for measuring speed, model architecture, task ability, empirical metrics, and safety.

PACES covers 5 key dimensions: 1) Performance: low latency, high token throughput. 2) Architecture: Transformer layers, RoPE, KV caching. 3) Capability: multi-turn code and command reasoning. 4) Evaluation: loss, perplexity, and task benchmarks. 5) Security: sandboxing, safe bash execution, and identity verification.
PACES is a comprehensive evaluation standard: Performance, Architecture, Capability, Evaluation, and Security, ensuring AI agents are both fast and robust.

Shree (URA-Shree) is an autonomous AI coding agent and custom Transformer language model built by Pritam from DIU.
Shree is an intelligent coding assistant equipped with a full development toolkit: sandboxed filesystem, persistent shell, AST indexer, Time Machine snapshots, and a from-scratch neural model.
URA-Shree is an end-to-end coding agent and language model designed to inspect workspaces, execute tools, and assist with software engineering without relying on third-party SDKs.
URA-Shree is a complete AI development platform featuring a custom Transformer model, agent loop, tool ecosystem, and web IDE created by Pritam from DIU.
